create_inference_client: create an InferenceClient instance with an HF_TOKEN API key for Hugging Face inference
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request using InferenceClient to call a Together-hosted Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model
send_user_message: send a user message to a conversational LLM via InferenceClient chat completions API
retrieve_completion_response: retrieve the assistant message from a chat completion response using choices[0].message
run_llm_inference: run non-streaming LLM inference with huggingface_hub InferenceClient for a Together-hosted model
